art_direction.applicability: authored selection plus caller-declared contexts; natural-language conditions are not inferred

must: Activate only for a user-requested garment design.

scope.description: An optional direction for one user-requested garment design. Place simultaneous- contrast color blocks, arcs, and bands according to the garment's real body, sleeve, collar, cuff, and seam panels. Let color rhythm cross adjacent pieces through related shapes while preserving the cut and construction. This applies Delaunay's color-and-fashion practice to a new garment without prescribing a dress, pattern, wearer, or historical design.
limitations: Activate only when the user requests a designed or patterned garment.
Preserve the requested garment type, silhouette, fit, material, color constraints, closures, and visible construction features.
Keep all designed color shapes within the garment silhouette; do not turn the wearer, mannequin, background, or second garment into a textile pattern unless requested.
Align blocks and arcs to actual garment panels and seams; do not erase buttons, pockets, lapels, cuffs, or openings.
Do not default to a dress, a specific historical costume, a wearer, or a named design.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a patterned or color-blocked garment.
rules.instruction: Place major color blocks and arcs inside the actual body, sleeve, and collar panels; let related edges meet or continue across seams where the user has requested a coordinated design.
rules.observable: Color rhythm follows the garment's cut and panel boundaries rather than floating as an unrelated overlay.
rules.reject_when: Pattern erases seams, crosses openings arbitrarily, or changes the garment silhouette.
rules.avoid: wallpaper-like all-over print or copied costume geometry

rules.applies_when: The requested garment includes closures, lapels, pockets, cuffs, or other structural details.
rules.instruction: Preserve each specified feature and leave enough contrast around it to identify its function; pattern edges may meet a seam but must not disguise the opening or fastener.
rules.observable: The garment remains wearable and recognizable at thumbnail size, with all requested closures and features visible.
rules.reject_when: A pocket vanishes, buttons merge into pattern, sleeves fuse into the body, or the neckline changes.
rules.avoid: decorative blocks that obscure garment construction

rules.applies_when: The user permits a multicolor garment design.
rules.instruction: Pair a small set of contrasting hues across neighboring garment panels, vary arc or block scale to create movement, and leave a few quiet intervals so the garment does not become an undifferentiated rainbow.
rules.observable: Adjacent panels create a pulsing color rhythm while each panel and the whole garment remain distinct.
rules.reject_when: Every panel receives an unrelated saturated hue or repeated shapes become an even mechanical tile.
rules.avoid: random rainbow fill, blur, motion streaks, or copied textile repeat

joint_checks.instruction: Let a limited rhythmic color design follow the user's actual garment panels, preserve every named construction feature, and keep the garment readable as a functional item.
joint_checks.observable: Simultaneous color contrast energizes the garment while its silhouette, seams, closures, and requested material stay clear.
